# `try`

- **Category:** Logical

## Signature

```text
try(expr: unknown | null, fallback: unknown | null) -> unknown | null
```

Returns the value of expr. Only when expr fails with a recoverable read failure (a missing or unreadable source, malformed or contract-mismatched data, or an allowed remote read that fails in transport) is fallback evaluated and returned instead; every other failure propagates. Any value expr produces, including a falsy one such as null, false, 0, or an empty string, list, or object, is a success.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expr` | `unknown \| null` | required |
| `fallback` | `unknown \| null` | required |

## Returns

`unknown | null`

Not fallible: a call whose arguments are valid always returns a value.

## Examples

```text
try(null, 7)
⇒ null
```

```text
try(0, 7)
⇒ 0
```
